Molecules with long alkyl chains (>=7 carbons) tend to be non-specific membrane disruptors with poor drug-likeness.

8. Acute aquatic toxicity

Matched alerts (2): Haloethyl amines (N-mustard) [NCCCl], Alkyl halide [CCCl]

9. Electrophilic agents
Electrophilic centers that can react with biological nucleophiles (protein thiols, DNA bases).
Matched alerts (1): Mustards [NCCCl]

10. Reactive metabolite formation (idiosyncratic toxicity)
Can form reactive metabolites via CYP metabolism that covalently modify liver proteins, triggering immune-mediated hepatotoxicity.
